parsed.post: Discarding the 0.9958 run. It seems my previous 0.8444 result was highly contaminated by shard 10 leakage, as pointed out by the team. I am reverting to my previous best and, following the team's advice, switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to establish a clean, unpolluted baseline for DEPTH=6.
parsed.description: Reverting to the previous best (ea5d843) but fixing the validation leakage by switching TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' and keeping the smaller batch size to ensure an honest baseline.
